thesis: PLMR closed at 161.08, 0.6% under the 52-week high, with RSI14 at 75.0 and price 12.4% above SMA20. The good news from the earnings gap is already priced in. The price is essentially at the 6-analyst mean target of 162.33, so consensus offers almost no upside. The card's own entry zone (155.7-159.0) is below the last close, so buying now means chasing outside the plan. The market is risk-off with high confidence and QQQ is below both its 50- and 200-day averages. Financials are one of the few strong sectors, which makes this a crowded defensive-rotation trade. The news feed was down, so offering, analyst-action, litigation and catastrophe-loss risk is unchecked after a one-month run of 20%. A property catastrophe insurer can gap down with no scheduled date. A full retrace to the pre-gap close of 144.04 would be a large loss against a stop that is only about 1.2 ATR from the zone.
